import Data.Multiset.Lemmas
import Order.Lattice

theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} [AddCommMonoid α] [PartialOrder α] [IsOrderedCancelAddMonoid α] [ExistsAddOfLE α] [LocallyFiniteOrder α] (a b c : α) :
  Multiset.map (fun x => c + x) (Multiset.Icc a b) = Multiset.Icc (c + a) (c + b) := by
  have h_add_order_preserving : ∀ x y, x ≤ y → c + x ≤ c + y :=
    λ x y h, add_le_add_right h
  have h_subset : Multiset.map (fun x => c + x) (Multiset.Icc a b) ⊆ Multiset.Icc (c + a) (c + b) :=
    begin
      intro x,
      rw Multiset.mem_map,
      split,
      { exact ⟨x, Multiset.mem_Icc_self x⟩ },
      { rintro ⟨y, h⟩,
        rcases Multiset.mem_Icc_iff.1 h with ⟨h1, h2⟩,
        exact ⟨c + y, Multiset.mem_Icc_self (c + y), add_le_add_left h1, add_le_add_left h2⟩ }
    end
  have h_subset_rev : Multiset.Icc (c + a) (c + b) ⊆ Multiset.map (fun x => c + x) (Multiset.Icc a b) :=
    begin
      intro x,
      rw Multiset.mem_Icc,
      split,
      { rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩,
        rcases exists_add_of_le.1 h1 with ⟨y, h3⟩,
        rcases exists_add_of_le.1 h2 with ⟨z, h4⟩,
        use y,
        exact ⟨Multiset.mem_Icc_self y, add_le_add_left h3, add_le_add_left h4⟩ },
      { exact ⟨x, Multiset.mem_Icc_self x⟩ }
    end
  exact Set.eq_of_subset_iff_subset h_subset_rev h_subset
